sourceChecks.text: He had two wives. The name of one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エルカナの二人の妻の一人としてハンナが名指され、子がいないと記される。

sourceChecks.text: but he gave a double portion to Hannah, for he loved Hannah, but the LORD had shut up her womb.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エルカナがハンナを愛し、主が彼女の胎を閉ざしていたと記される。

sourceChecks.text: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エルカナが泣いて食べないハンナに語りかける。

sourceChecks.text: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of the LORD’s temple.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 食事の後、ハンナが主の前で祈るため立ち上がる。

sourceChecks.text: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ハンナが心の中で祈る。

sourceChecks.text: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before the LORD.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ハンナが自らを悲しむ心の女と説明する。

sourceChecks.text: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped the LORD, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エルカナとハンナについて、主が彼女を覚えたと記す。

sourceChecks.text: When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him of the LORD.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ハンナが男児を産み、サムエルと名づける。

sourceChecks.text: But Hannah didn’t go up, for she said to her husband, “Not until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD, and stay there forever.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 子が乳離れした後に主のもとへ連れて行くと夫に告げる。

sourceChecks.text: Hannah prayed, and said, “My heart exults in the LORD! My horn is exalted in the LORD. My mouth is enlarged over my enemies, because I rejoice in your salvation.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ハンナの祈りが始まる。

sourceChecks.text: The LORD visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before the LORD.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 主がハンナを顧み、彼女がさらに子どもを産んだと記す。
